Microsoft Visual C++ Runtime

The Windows installer includes the release Microsoft.VC143.CRT runtime files
from the Visual Studio Build Tools redistribution directory. These files are
Microsoft components, not part of OcPlayer's open-source license.

Redistribution is governed by the Microsoft Visual Studio license and its
REDIST list. The build must use the release redistribution directory; debug
runtime files are not redistributable and must not be included.

Visual Studio licensing:
https://visualstudio.microsoft.com/license-terms/

Visual Studio 2022 redistribution list:
https://learn.microsoft.com/visualstudio/releases/2022/redistribution
